item.title: Nvidia Faces SEC Civil Probe After CEO Huang's Departure
item.description:
The SEC has opened a civil probe into whether Nvidia's disclosures misled investors, following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation amid an extramarital affair involving an alleged Chinese spy. The investigation compounds Commerce Department scrutiny of chip diversion through Megaspeed and congressional pressure, with Nvidia shares down over 10% since Huang's exit even as quarterly revenue hit $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year.

原文标题：英伟达遭 SEC 民事调查 黄仁勋离职后股价跌超 10%

Why it matters：全球市值最高芯片公司遭遇监管调查与 CEO 离职双重冲击，直接牵动 AI 算力供应链与出口管制走向。

item.title: Nvidia Posts $115.8B Quarterly Revenue as Data Center Sales Double
item.description:
Nvidia reported fiscal Q3 2027 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year and above its $108 billion guidance, joining the small club of companies to top $100 billion in a single quarter. Data center revenue reached $107.6 billion, up 110%, while edge computing including consumer gaming brought in $8.2 billion, up 42%. Interim CEO Colette Kress did not initially address former CEO Jensen Huang's departure or a possible return, topics likely to surface on the analyst call.

原文标题：英伟达 Q3 营收 1158 亿美元 数据中心翻倍

Why it matters：英伟达单季营收首破千亿美元且数据中心同比翻倍，是 AI 算力需求景气度的关键风向标。

item.title: SEC Opens Civil Investigation Into Nvidia Disclosures to Investors
item.description:
The SEC has opened a civil investigation into whether Nvidia's disclosures misled investors, with scrutiny centering on a reporting change: Singapore billings reached $10.2B, or 22% of revenue, in the quarter ended July 2025, after which Nvidia stopped breaking out that region, saying chips almost always ship elsewhere. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent gave the board and outside counsel 10 days to explain whether the company pushed 'seemingly illicit sales' to lift earnings.

原文标题：美 SEC 对英伟达信息披露展开民事调查

Why it matters：监管调查叠加收入确认口径争议，直接触及英伟达财务披露可信度这一核心变量。

item.title: Nvidia Posts $183.3B Nine-Month Profit, Up 138% Year on Year
item.description:
Nvidia reported $293.68B in revenue and $183.30B in net income for the first nine months of fiscal 2027, up 98.69% and 137.72% year on year, with gross margin rising to 74.9%. Third-quarter revenue reached $115.84B and net income $65.29B, both roughly doubling year on year, underscoring still-accelerating AI compute demand.

原文标题：英伟达前三季净利 1833 亿美元 同比增 138%

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力景气度最直接的财务刻度，营收与利润翻倍增长为基础设施投资周期提供了硬数据。

item.title: Altman Says OpenAI Uses AI to Speed Up Next Model Development
item.description:
In a Semafor interview, Sam Altman confirmed that OpenAI uses its own models to accelerate development of next-generation models, an early form of recursive self-improvement (RSI). He explicitly denied any push-button, fully autonomous self-improvement loop, saying the company could lean further into RSI but cannot do so safely today.

原文标题：Altman 称 OpenAI 已用 AI 加速研发新模型

Why it matters：OpenAI 掌门人首次较明确地界定 RSI 的实际使用边界，是观察前沿实验室研发范式与安全取舍的一手表态。

item.title: Cutting Generative AI Costs by Replacing Model Calls with Rules
item.description:
An AWS blog post argues that the biggest cost lever in generative AI systems is whether a model is called at all, since deterministic steps such as input validation, formatting and routing can be handled by rule-based code. It offers a decision framework mapping each workflow step to deterministic code, a constrained decision call, or a right-sized model on Amazon Bedrock, and recommends starting with one high-volume workflow to measure how much of it never needed a model.

原文标题：用规则替代模型调用可大幅削减生成式 AI 成本

Why it matters：提供可落地的成本优化决策框架，对构建生产级 AI 系统的工程团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: Amazon SageMaker Adds KV Cache-Aware Routing for Real-Time Endpoints
item.description:
Amazon SageMaker AI introduced KV cache-aware routing for real-time endpoints, using cache state reported by the model container to send each request to an instance holding a long cached prefix match that is not overloaded. It targets multi-turn chat, long shared prompts and RAG workloads, and is enabled via one environment variable plus the KV_AWARE routing strategy in the endpoint configuration, with no client API changes.

原文标题：SageMaker 实时端点新增 KV 缓存感知路由

Why it matters：这是云厂商推理底座在缓存复用调度上的实用工程更新，对部署 LLM 服务的团队有直接降本增效价值。

item.title: Critical OpenJDK Base64 Decoder Flaw Enables Remote Code Execution
item.description:
Researchers disclosed Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938), a memory-corruption vulnerability in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder rated 9.2 CRITICAL under CVSS 4.0. The flaw lies in the optimized x86-64 SIMD code path used to accelerate decoding and can lead to remote code execution. Given Java's position as the third most popular language and its role in 90% of Fortune 500 companies, the impact spans banking, aviation and telecom infrastructure, making patching urgent.

原文标题：OpenJDK Base64 解码器曝 9.2 分严重漏洞

Why it matters：影响面极广的 OpenJDK 远程代码执行漏洞，所有 Java 服务端与关键基础设施运维方都需立即评估。

item.title: Australia Launches Agentaus 1, a 220B Sovereign AI Model
item.description:
Australian firm Trellis Data has released Agentaus 1, a 220B-parameter model built around data sovereignty: prompts stay on Australian servers and are never used for training. The company reports 84.4% on MMLU-Pro, ranking 43rd among foundation models, and says it runs on two GPUs where comparable models need four.

原文标题：澳大利亚推出 220B 参数主权大模型 Agentaus 1

Why it matters：这是主权 AI 与中等规模模型效率优化的结合案例，对关注区域化部署和推理成本的读者有参考价值。

item.title: GPT-6.2 Astra Tops AA-3D Interactive 3D Benchmark
item.description:
Artificial Analysis reports that GPT-6.2 Astra ranks first on AA-3D, its benchmark for building interactive 3D experiences, winning 139 of 152 human head-to-head votes. The result signals that spatial and interactive content generation is now being folded into standardized frontier-model evaluation.

Why it matters：首个针对交互式 3D 生成的公开人类偏好榜单结果，反映前沿模型能力评测的新维度。

item.title: Zero Data Retention Hinges on API Design Not Vendor Promises
item.description:
Fireworks AI CEO Lin Qiao argues that zero data retention in AI infrastructure is widely misunderstood and actually depends on API design: customer-managed retention (upload, use, delete) versus ephemeral processing (send, compute, return). Batch APIs at OpenAI, Bedrock, Gemini and Fireworks follow the former, retaining data until deletion, while inference APIs like Chat Completions follow the latter. Customers retain control in both models, but ephemeral processing is preferable where workflows allow, avoiding forgotten datasets and missed delete calls.

原文标题：零数据留存取决于 API 设计而非厂商承诺

Why it matters：厘清了企业采购 AI 服务时最易混淆的数据留存概念，并给出可操作的 API 选型判断框架。

Marktechpost (@Marktechpost) · compute · signal 58/100

item.title: Perplexity Hits $1B Annual Revenue Run Rate on a Fifth of Anthropic's Burn
item.description:
Perplexity has crossed a $1B annual revenue run rate, up from under $250M at the start of 2026 and past $750M in August, founder Aravind Srinivas said. The unusually low cash burn is structural: Perplexity does not train a frontier model and instead routes tasks to Claude, GPT and Gemini, betting customers care that the job gets done rather than which model ran it. By contrast, Anthropic's S-1 shows $7.3B of operating cash burned across 2023 and 2024 to reach roughly the same revenue level.

原文标题：Perplexity 年化收入破 10 亿美元 烧钱仅为 Anthropic 五分之一

Why it matters：以收入与烧钱对比揭示“不自研基座、做模型路由”这一商业路径的可行性，对判断 AI 应用层与模型层格局有实质参考价值。

item.title: AWS Agent Registry Adds Custom Metadata Schemas for Agent Governance
item.description:
AWS Agent Registry now supports custom metadata schemas, letting administrators define organization-wide key-value attributes that every agent, MCP server, and skill record must carry. This fills a prior gap where teams could not define or store organization-specific facts such as business units, owners, and risk classifications, making approvals and discovery more dependable.

Why it matters：这是云厂商注册表产品的一次治理能力补齐，对使用 AWS 构建智能体资产目录的团队有实际参考价值。

It presents three tested OAuth configurations, including per-user Snowflake OAuth and three-legged OAuth, letting enterprises extend existing identity and authorization controls into the agent layer instead of relying on broad service accounts or custom auth builds.

item.title: Google and Penn State Introduce SIM to Carry Agent Self-Improvement Across Models
item.description:
A new Google and Penn State paper proposes Self-Improvement Memory (SIM): when an LLM rewrites an agent's harness, the code that runs prompts and tools, each edit is logged with the problem it targeted, its reasoning and its measured result. After switching models or benchmarks, an optimizer reads this log to decide which prior edits to keep or revise, preventing regressions. Moving a Claude Opus 5.5 harness to Gemini 3.8 Flash workspace tasks, SIM raised scores from 68.41 to 84.75 versus 73.42 without the log, and led in 9 of 10 repeated coding runs by 2.36 points on average.

原文标题：谷歌与宾大提出 SIM 让智能体自我改进记忆跨模型迁移

Why it matters：首次系统化解决智能体 harness 自我改写后的跨模型迁移与可解释性问题，实验数据明确且方法可直接复用。

item.title: Genesis AI Raises $500M Series A at $3.5B Valuation
item.description:
Robotics startup Genesis AI has closed a $500M Series A at a $3.5B valuation. The capital funds a single thesis: teaching robots hand skills by recording humans at work through a glove that captures touch and force, with its GENE model self-practicing in parallel across many virtual environments inside the Genesis World physics simulator. The practical payoff is evaluation, where scenes and objects can be varied to find where a skill breaks before committing to costly physical trials.

原文标题：Genesis AI 融资 5 亿美元 估值 35 亿美元

Why it matters：大额融资叠加触觉数据采集与仿真自练习的明确技术路线，是具身智能领域值得关注的产业动向。

item.title: Book Teaches Browser Internals by Building One in Python
item.description:
Web Browser Engineering is an open technical book that builds a basic but complete web browser in roughly two thousand lines of Python, covering networking, HTML parsing, layout, rendering, and JavaScript. It targets developers who want a systematic, hands-on understanding of how browsers work internally.

原文标题：从零构建浏览器 千行 Python 讲透底层原理

Why it matters：以工程实践方式系统讲解浏览器底层原理，对前端与系统开发者有长期学习价值。

item.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Hits 1,129 Tokens per Second on Four AMD MI355X GPUs
item.description:
Sciforium deployed DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on four AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, reaching 1,129 output tokens/sec at P90 while keeping DeepSeek's original weights. The gains come from a traffic-tuned speculative decoding drafter that raises draft length to seven tokens, plus kernel work fusing small ops and overlapping all-reduce with compute. The result demonstrates AMD GPU viability for production LLM inference on real customer traffic.

原文标题：DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在 4 张 AMD MI355X 上实现 1129 tokens/s

Why it matters：以真实生产流量在 AMD GPU 上刷新推理吞吐记录，对算力选型与推理优化有直接参考价值。

item.title: Altman Says PCB Laminate Shortage Once Capped OpenAI Sales
item.description:
Speaking at a Semafor event, Sam Altman said OpenAI was at times unable to sell more AI services because the world had run out of PCB laminate, the base material for circuit boards. The remark extends the AI compute bottleneck debate beyond GPUs to the most upstream electronic-materials supply chain, underscoring how AI infrastructure expansion is constrained by conventional manufacturing.

原文标题：Altman 称 PCB 覆铜板短缺曾卡住 OpenAI 卖服务

Why it matters：头部厂商首次公开承认材料级供应链成为 AI 服务交付的硬约束，对理解算力扩张边界有参考价值。

item.title: Google Opens Free Personal Agent Tasks to Hundreds of Millions
item.description:
Google has renamed its Spark agent to Task and made it free, dropping the $19.99-a-month AI Pro requirement. Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, it is available in the U.S., Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia and India, and can call businesses, check out via Google Pay and turn forwarded emails into calendar events. Payments rely on Visa and Mastercard card tokens, a user-set spending cap and a confirmation step before purchase. The free tier undercuts OpenAI's Dots at $100 a month and matches Meta's Muse, reportedly past 3M weekly users.

原文标题：谷歌向数亿用户免费开放 Gemini 个人智能体

Why it matters：谷歌把付费智能体免费开放给数亿用户，是消费级 Agent 商业化路径的重要转折。

item.title: 美国新许可规则冻结 4.8 亿美元 GPU 贷款
item.description:
美国新出台的 AI 芯片许可规则已实质阻断一笔 4.8 亿美元融资：新加坡云服务商 Aolani Cloud 原计划通过星展银行安排三年期贷款，采购英伟达 GPU 供字节跳动在马来西亚使用。新规要求新加坡、马来西亚等地的数据中心运营商在购买先进 AI 芯片前须获得许可，并直接针对“远程访问”模式，即中国企业租用从未入境中国的算力。已有五家银行的信贷人员讨论退出，部分人士称该融资安排已“死亡”，因为放款可能违反规则。

Why it matters：这是美国芯片出口管制从硬件流向延伸至“远程算力租赁”的关键转折，直接冲击中国企业的海外算力获取路径与金融机构的信贷决策。

item.title: 开源决策模型 Karpo 登顶 300 项评测榜首
item.description:
